description: This file defines enums, structs, and functions related to remote gateway probing and authentication issues within the OpenClaw project. It handles the logic for checking the status of remote gateways, managing authentication states, and generating user-visible messages.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous probe to assess the state of the remote gateway, returning a result indicating readiness, authentication issues, or failure.

methods.name: isValidWsUrl
methods.description: Validates whether a given WebSocket URL is properly formatted for remote gateway connection.

methods.name: sshCheckCommand
methods.description: Constructs an SSH command for checking connectivity to a specified target with given identity.

methods.name: formatSSHFailure
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message based on the failure response from an SSH check.
